# A bulletin sent with an ID of its own keeps it, upper-cased, and the same ID
# can't be used twice.
@session Q2TEST
< de Q1BBS>
> SB ALL $123_q3bbs
< Title:
> News
< Enter the message.  End it with /EX or Ctrl-Z on a line of its own.
> First line.
> Last line.^Z
< Message 1 saved, ID 123_Q3BBS.
< de Q1BBS>
> SB ALL $123_Q3BBS
< Title:
> News again
< Enter the message.  End it with /EX or Ctrl-Z on a line of its own.
> /ex
< That message ID has been seen before, so the message wasn't saved.
< de Q1BBS>

# The Ctrl-Z ended the last line of text, which is kept.
> R 1
< Msg #1  B  ID 123_Q3BBS
< From:  Q2TEST
< To:    ALL
< Date:  31-Oct-26 12:34Z
< Title: News
< Path:  Q1BBS
<
< First line.
< Last line.
<
< de Q1BBS>

# An empty message is fine, and a range lists just those in it.
> ST Q1TEST@Q1BBS.#77.GBR
< Title:
>
< Enter the message.  End it with /EX or Ctrl-Z on a line of its own.
> /EX
< Message 2 saved, ID 2_Q1BBS.
< de Q1BBS>
> L 2-2
< Msg#  TS Size  To     @BBS     From      Date   Title
< 2     TN    37 Q1TEST Q1BBS.#77.GBR Q2TEST    31-Oct
< de Q1BBS>
> L< Q2TEST
< Msg#  TS Size  To     @BBS     From      Date   Title
< 2     TN    37 Q1TEST Q1BBS.#77.GBR Q2TEST    31-Oct
< 1     BN    60 ALL             Q2TEST    31-Oct News
< de Q1BBS>
